bio.text: Randy Torres is serving his first term in the Arkansas House of Representatives, representing District 17, which includes a portion of Benton County.
He is Market President for Generations Bank in Siloam Springs and earlier owned and operated businesses in the service, manufacturing, ranching and real estate industries.
He holds a B.S. in Animal Science from Texas A&M University (1993) and a Master's in Ministry and an MBA from John Brown University, and he lives in Siloam Springs.
